office_does: A Snohomish County District Court judge hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor criminal cases, traffic infractions, small claims, civil cases up to the district-court limit, and protection orders, and is elected by the voters of the court's electoral district to a four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Jennifer Rancourt, on the District Court since 2019, is the only candidate. Elected by Cascade District voters only.

candidates.summary: District Court judge since 2019 and 2022-23 presiding judge, previously a trial attorney for 17 years, running unopposed.
highlights: District Court judge since 2019; presiding judge 2022-23; Dean of the State Judicial College, 2024 [S1]
17 years as a trial attorney in Snohomish County and 9 years as a judge pro tem [S1]
Says she formed the county's first driver's-license relicensing program [S1]
